content.text: Redis automatically deletes expired keys. Set expiry at write time with EX or EXPIRE.

content.code:
SET token:abc "xyz" EX 900     # 15 minutes
EXPIRE session:1 1800          # 30 minutes
PERSIST session:1              # remove expiry
PTTL token:abc                 # milliseconds remaining

content.text: When Redis runs out of memory, the eviction policy decides what to remove. Set maxmemory-policy in redis.conf.

content.code:
maxmemory 256mb
maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru   # LRU eviction on all keys

questions.question: What does allkeys-lru eviction do?
options: Removes the most recently used keys
Removes the least recently used keys
Removes keys with the shortest TTL
questions.explanation: LRU (Least Recently Used) eviction removes keys that have not been accessed recently.

faq.q: What eviction policy should I use for a pure cache?
faq.a: allkeys-lru is the most common choice — it evicts the least recently used keys across all keys.
